selection_note: 官方测试集 conversation，原始轮数大于 10 且接近 10，统一截取前 10 轮。
topic: What are the main breeds of goat?

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 1
sentences: Rewrite: What are the main breeds of goat?
Answer: Abaza...Zhongwei
Source URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_goat_breeds

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 2
sentences: Rewrite: Tell me about boer goats
Answer: The Boer goat is a breed of goat that was developed in South Africa in the early 1900s for meat production. Their name is derived from the Afrikaans (Dutch) word boer, meaning farmer.
Source URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boer_goat

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 3
sentences: Rewrite: What breed of goats is good for meat

Answer: Before Boer goats became available in the United States in the late 1980s, Spanish goats were the standard meat goat breed, especially in the South. These goats are descendants of the goats brought by Spanish explorers, making their way to the United States via Mexico.
Source URL: https://www.thespruce.com/choose-meat-goat-breeds-3016784

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 4
sentences: Rewrite: Are angora goats good for meat?
Answer: Surplus or cull Angora and cashmere goats are also used for meat, although a good fiber-producing goat is generally a poor meat goat and vice versa.
Source URL: https://www.motherearthnews.com/homesteading-and-livestock/goats-for-milk-meat-and-more

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 5
sentences: Rewrite: Are boer goats good for meat?
Answer: Boer goats were bred in South Africa for meat and selected for their superior body shape, high growth rate, and fertility.
Source URL: https://www.thespruce.com/choose-meat-goat-breeds-3016784

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 6
sentences: Rewrite: What are pygmy goats used for?

Answer: While Pygmy goats are most commonly kept as pets or used as meat goats, they can also be used for milk production. Pygmy goats can produce, on average, between one to two quarts of 4.5% to 11% butterfat milk.
Source URL: https://www.wideopenpets.com/everything-you-need-to-know-about-the-pygmy-goat/

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 7
sentences: Rewrite: What is the best goat for fiber production?
Answer: Mohair goats are the most productive fiber producing animals.
Source URL: https://info.mannapro.com/homestead/raising-fiber-goats-101

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 8
sentences: Rewrite: How long do Angora goats live?
Answer: In our flock, it is not uncommon for our girls to go 9-11 years- undoubtedly we could push them longer, but they do not stay unless they can put kids on the ground.
Source URL: https://angoragoat.com/

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 9
sentences: Rewrite: Can you milk Angora goats?
Answer: Angora mothers have been known to not produce enough milk if they give birth to more than 1.
Source URL: https://homestead.motherearthnews.com/making-money-angora-goats-part-1/

context.title: QReCC conversation 2 turn 10
sentences: Rewrite: How many goats can you have per acre?
Answer: Poor ground may support 2-4 goats per acre while better pasture may be able to support 6-8 goats per acre.
Source URL: http://livestocktrail.illinois.edu/sheepnet/paperDisplay.cfm?ContentID=9808
